versions.changelog: Add pitfall: Windows CRLF token files send a trailing CR and fail auth regardless of token validity
Add two field pitfalls: /users/{name}/repos lists public repos only (use /user/repos?visibility=all), and shell shims silently dropping env vars on child processes
Add private-repo 404 rule: unauthenticated 404 on pages/raw is privacy hiding, not deletion; confirm via authenticated GET /repos 200 + private:true
Add not_for field (agent routing exclusion) per skill-design-guide Principle Two: agent-consumption-first design
Add structure sections (Hard Rules, Failure Handling, Output Format, step tags) and Chinese summary with trigger keywords
Initial public release: diagnosis workflow + token failure-mode decision tree
